row: If you’re looking for a rehabilitation hospital for you or your loved one, we hope you will consider Northern Colorado Rehabilitation Hospital. We provide specialized rehabilitative services to patients in Northern Colorado and surrounding areas who are recovering from disabilities caused by injuries, illnesses, or chronic medical conditions.
